review_notes: Thirty-three existing recovered definitions now have structured control flow with no remaining jumps. Focused review preserves callback order, cached versus fresh reads, native event gates, and gameplay quirks. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.

Sacrifice scans retain separate in-play queries and source exclusion. Aura dispatch preserves casting callbacks, attachment validation, upkeep checks and death-trigger ordering. Coalition Relic preserves instance-query counts and cleanup resets; Clockwork preserves its captured displayed X and event-specific AI hints.

Random permanent selection retains its initial hand-count gate, host/client packet paths, and fresh network-mode check after scans. Compost, Grindclock, Sarkhan and Scrying Glass retain their AI scoring and selection behavior.

Bestow applies attachment effects on characteristic events only along the original branches, with other paths still gated by trigger context. Life/Death preserves its empty-graveyard early return on resolution. Descent into Madness preserves cached exile requirements and repeated target availability checks.
Single combined incremental build. Historical audits, full inventory regeneration, reccmp refresh and gameplay tests deferred.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
